provenance.source: Assistant-authored synthetic defense-review queries; no case material, personal data, or runtime model output.
provenance.labeling: Expected kinds and one-line rationales were authored before measuring the original router; labels do not encode observed outputs.
provenance.scope_limit: A deterministic intent regression set, not a representative user study or a retrieval-quality evaluation.

rubric.exact: Supported explicit phrase, uppercase Boolean, or NEAR/n or BEFORE/n syntax; exact syntax takes precedence over enumeration, while clear natural-language questions and non-exhaustive explanation requests remain questions.
rubric.question: Natural-language questions, non-exhaustive imperatives, unsupported syntax, and ambiguous fragments; prefer question to exact and do not infer expensive enumeration.
rubric.every_source: An explicit exhaustive retrieval request for a source population or an established bare exhaustive command; never infer enumeration merely from all, each, or every in prose.
rubric.ambiguity: Rationales explicitly mark genuine ambiguity and choose question unless valid explicit exact syntax resolves the ambiguity.
rubric.freeze: The test pins the SHA-256 of the complete UTF-8 JSON file, including its final newline; intentional fixture changes require review and a new digest.
